projects.name: Notifications History - Notix
projects.desc:
Notix – Notification Backup & History is your private notification vault.
It automatically saves every notification you receive, so you never lose an important alert again.
Your data is fully encrypted on your device and never sent to any server. No unnecessary permissions, no trackers, and no complicated setup — just grant Notification Access and Notix handles the rest
